properties.label: Weighted choice fragment
properties.text: Centre one compact dark product fragment containing a quiet question title bar, four aligned choice rows and a final total; each row pairs a selection control, name and numeric share.

properties.label: Question-to-total hierarchy
properties.text: Order the typographic hierarchy as question, selected rows, numeric total and then metadata.

properties.label: Violet-black and muted lilac
properties.text: Use a violet-black ground, muted lilac selection fill and small luminous ticks.

properties.label: Inset divided choice surface
properties.text: Place the choices on a slightly lifted dark surface with a restrained inset border and fine row dividers.

properties.label: Operable weighted choices
properties.text: When used as product UI, make weighted choices operable, maintain a total of 100 and expose every value accessibly.

properties.label: Frozen-example disclosure
properties.text: When rendered as an illustration, label the fragment as an example rather than implying hidden functionality.

properties.label: Selection and value acceptance
properties.text: Make selection evident without hue alone, and keep every name, weight and the total legible on small screens.
